messages:
alyssa: quick sync — i’m proposing a BYO keystore field pilot w/ 3 customers next sprint. want to surface the launch hypotheses, gating criteria, and clear asks for eng/security/sales. pls chime in.
rahul: sounds good. main eng risk is evidence export throughput + handling legal-hold spikes. do we have expected qps?
alyssa: for pilot customers we expect ~5–20 exports/day, but peak legal-hold could be +1k requests for a short window. hypothesis: we can tolerate async export (24–48h) for pilot.
tanya: security note — customer-managed keys require HSM-backed wrapping for audit. we need KMS attestation + rotation policy documented. also must confirm we can sign evidence manifests.
marc: customers asked for pricing guardrails. they will pay a premium for BYOK but want a predictable SLA. suggested: two tiers — async(48h) cheaper, expedited(4h) premium. sales asks: clear SLA and rollback path for expired keys.
jamie: legal: retention/legal-hold rules vary. need an option to freeze export when legal hold flagged. also chain-of-custody metadata must be immutable and searchable.
rahul: engineering asks: define runbook for failed exports, retry/backoff, and a way to quarantine exports tied to revoked keys. propose an ops API: `POST /exports/{id}/quarantine` and `GET /exports/{id}/status`.
alyssa: good. proposed launch criteria for pilot: 1) successful end-to-end export with BYOK for 3 customers, 2) ops runbook + playbook (oncall steps), 3) telemetry for latency/cost per-export, 4) legal-hold flow validated.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to staging on 1843213600, production rollout gated by canary success and security signoff.
tanya: also require threat model update + SOC2 control mapping for evidence integrity. this must be done before prod.
marc: tradeoffs to highlight to customers: we will not guarantee sub-minute exports in pilot; key revocation within customer KMS could block export and may require manual recovery (we will provide assisted recovery for pilot).
rahul: technical mitigation ideas: prefix-level KV caching of evidence metadata, chunked export streaming, and back-pressure on ingest when export backlog > X. need to pick X.
alyssa: decision needed from product: set backlog threshold X (suggest 5k export items) and pick SLA tiers. also confirm whether we require HSM attestation for pilot or can accept software-wrapped keys for MVP.
marc: customer feedback — two customers demand HSM; one is ok with SW-wrapped for pilot if there's attestation roadmap.
jamie: legal comfortable with SW-wrapped only if documented limitations and consent captured.
tanya: security strongly prefers HSM but can allow SW for one customer if ops and legal sign off. require a mitigation plan in case of key compromise.
alyssa: ok action items: - product to decide SLA tiers + backlog threshold by EOD Friday - eng to prototype `quarantine` endpoints + export status page in next sprint - security to draft attestation checklist & mitigation plan - legal to prepare consent language for SW-wrapped fallback - sales to align pilots and pricing.
marc: will sync with customers and consolidate pricing asks.
rahul: i'll start spike for streaming/chunking and post early perf numbers.
ops-bot: reminder: please add runbook to `#runbooks` before staging deploy.
alyssa: thanks all — tagging this as a decision thread. if no objections by EOD we’ll lock pilot scope and publicize to customers. :thumbsup:
